name: HostingRaja
tagline: India-based web hosting with cPanel, local data centers and 24/7 support
description: HostingRaja is an India-focused web host offering cPanel shared, reseller and VPS hosting from Indian data centers, aimed at Indian businesses and beginners.
about: HostingRaja is an Indian web hosting provider running its own data centers in India, positioned toward Indian site owners who want lower latency to a local audience plus local-language support. Its shared hosting lineup is built on cPanel with Softaculous for one-click app installs, split into tiers such as WordPress Hosting, Web Hosting and Premium Hosting, alongside separate reseller, VPS, dedicated and cloud hosting lines.

Entry-level pricing starts low: WordPress hosting from around ₹49/month, general web hosting from around ₹104/month, and Premium hosting from around ₹299/month, with reseller plans starting near ₹1,248/month and VPS from around ₹2,999/month. Higher tiers add perks like a free domain, dedicated IP and automatic backups that the entry tier lacks.

As with most budget hosts, the advertised entry price is a promotional rate tied to a longer prepaid term rather than the ongoing monthly cost — HostingRaja does not publish exact renewal figures as prominently as the intro price, so confirm the renewal rate at checkout before committing to a multi-year term.
policies: HostingRaja advertises a 30-day money-back guarantee across its hosting plans, letting new customers cancel within the first month for a refund. Some independent reviews note the refund can be conditioned on demonstrating a technical issue with the service rather than a true no-questions-asked window, so it's worth reading the exact refund terms on HostingRaja's own site before purchasing.
